children: Neurology drugmaker's Q3 revenue rose 23% yr/yr, driven by DAYBUE and NUPLAZID sales
DAYBUE Q3 net sales up 39% yr/yr; NUPLAZID sales up 14% yr/yr
Company raised 2026 DAYBUE sales guidance and narrowed total revenue and NUPLAZID ranges
Company revises 2026 total revenue guidance to $1.265–$1.295 bln from $1.24–$1.30 bln
DAYBUE 2026 net sales guidance raised to $505–$520 mln from $480–$510 mln
NUPLAZID 2026 net sales guidance narrowed to $760–$775 mln from $760–$790 mln
DAYBUE STIX UPTAKE - Co said strong uptake of DAYBUE STIX drove 39% yr/yr growth in DAYBUE sales
NUPLAZID DEMAND - Co attributed NUPLAZID sales growth to underlying demand and expanded commercial reach
EUROPEAN LAUNCH - Co cited initial momentum from DAYBU launch in Germany as contributing to results
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc. is $31.92, about 55.2% above its November 3 closing price of $20.57
The stock recently traded at 24 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 40 three months ago
